business_objective: Design a rigorous, grounded measurement framework, event tracking plan, experiment portfolio (PEXP-001..003), media allocation logic, and diagnostic decision rules for local developer acquisition, strictly preserving unknown baselines without fabricating campaign telemetry.

measurement_framework.causal_attribution_hierarchy: RCTs > Lift Tests > Quasi-Experiments > MTA > Platform-Reported

primary_channels.channel_name: Technical Developer Communities & Hacker News / Reddit
primary_channels.rationale: High concentration of active open-weight model practitioners seeking CLI tooling (EVID-FORUM-F119C750).
primary_channels.measurement_requirement: First-party referral traffic and documentation engagement depth.

secondary_channels.rationale: Visual demonstration of CLI setup and port 11434 REST API in short-form video (EVID-YT-3A9BE9D4).
secondary_channels.measurement_requirement: 3-second hook retention and landing page click rate.

experimental_channels.channel_name: Technical Search Capture ('run llama locally', 'offline llm runner')
experimental_channels.rationale: Search discovery identified technical queries; demand volume and conversion rate require validation (EVID-SRCH-132D6868).
experimental_channels.measurement_requirement: Controlled 21-day keyword search capture test to establish search install intent.

deferred_channels.channel_name: Broad Non-Technical Consumer Paid Social Ads
deferred_channels.rationale: Current evidence is strongly developer-oriented and does not establish broad non-technical consumer-market fit.
Enterprise transaction baselines and monetization features are currently UNKNOWN (TRANSACTION_DATA = MISSING).
deferred_channels.measurement_requirement: Deferred pending enterprise compliance tier validation.

performance_hypotheses: Friction-focused terminal setup hook (VAR-A) outperforms generic announcements in 3s hook retention.
Localhost REST API specificity hook (VAR-B) drives higher technical documentation depth.
Upfront VRAM compatibility CTA (VAR-C) pre-qualifies traffic and increases downstream CLI installation completion.

experiment_portfolio.title: Creative Hook Mechanism Test: Setup Friction vs REST API Specificity
experiment_portfolio.question: Does framing local LLM adoption around setup friction (VAR-A) generate higher initial developer retention than REST API specificity (VAR-B)?
experiment_portfolio.hypothesis: Friction-focused hook (VAR-A) outperforms API specificity (VAR-B) in initial 3-second developer hook retention.
experiment_portfolio.control: VAR-B (REST API daemon specificity hook: 'Did you know Ollama runs on port 11434?')
experiment_portfolio.treatment: VAR-A (Friction recognition hook: 'Tired of configuring CUDA drivers?')
experiment_portfolio.target_segment: Software developers on macOS, Linux, and Windows browsing technical content
guardrails: Bounce Rate must not increase by > 10%
experiment_portfolio.randomization_or_assignment: 50/50 randomized delivery across identical audience cohorts
experiment_portfolio.sample_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires baseline rate, MDE, and statistical power parameters)
experiment_portfolio.duration_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires traffic volume, MDE, variance, conversion lag, and business cycle calculation)
experiment_portfolio.stop_condition: Halt early if treatment exhibits severe anomaly (>50% bounce increase) or tracking failure
experiment_portfolio.analysis_method: Two-sample proportion test with 95% confidence intervals; INCONCLUSIVE supported if power is inadequate
experiment_portfolio.limitations: Does not measure local CLI execution after download.
experiment_portfolio.next_decision: If VAR-A wins, scale friction-first creative across technical channels; if inconclusive, maintain balanced distribution.

experiment_portfolio.title: Hardware Qualification CTA Test: VRAM Tool vs Direct Download
experiment_portfolio.question: Does offering upfront model-to-VRAM hardware qualification (VAR-C) reduce early onboarding drop-off compared to direct binary download CTA?
experiment_portfolio.hypothesis: Providing an upfront model-to-VRAM compatibility guide pre-qualifies developers and improves downstream CLI setup completion.
experiment_portfolio.control: Direct 'Download Ollama' CTA on landing page hero
experiment_portfolio.treatment: Interactive 'Check Model Hardware Compatibility Chart' CTA on landing page hero
experiment_portfolio.target_segment: Developers arriving on landing page with bounded GPU VRAM
guardrails: Total initiated downloads must not decrease significantly
experiment_portfolio.randomization_or_assignment: Server-side A/B split on landing page hero module
experiment_portfolio.sample_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires baseline rate, MDE, and statistical power parameters)
experiment_portfolio.duration_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires traffic volume, MDE, variance, conversion lag, and business cycle calculation)
experiment_portfolio.stop_condition: Halt if treatment reduces total download intent by > 20%
experiment_portfolio.analysis_method: Relative risk comparison and bootstrap confidence intervals
experiment_portfolio.limitations: Downstream setup completion requires opt-in verification or follow-up feedback telemetry.
experiment_portfolio.next_decision: If VRAM qualification improves downstream activation, make hardware sizing the standard onboarding step.

experiment_portfolio.title: Search Intent Validation Test: Technical Keyword Demand Capture
experiment_portfolio.question: Does commercial intent exist for technical search queries ('run llama locally', 'offline llm runner')?
experiment_portfolio.hypothesis: Developers searching for local model execution keywords have high downstream documentation and installation intent.
experiment_portfolio.treatment: Targeted search capture on exact-match technical developer queries
experiment_portfolio.target_segment: High-intent developers searching technical local LLM queries
guardrails: Maintain strict negative keyword list to prevent consumer/gaming traffic leakage
experiment_portfolio.randomization_or_assignment: Search ad group geographic holdout or time-series switchback test
experiment_portfolio.sample_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires baseline rate, MDE, and statistical power parameters)
experiment_portfolio.duration_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires traffic volume, MDE, variance, conversion lag, and business cycle calculation)
experiment_portfolio.stop_condition: Halt if search queries demonstrate zero download intent after initial sample threshold
experiment_portfolio.analysis_method: Pre/post quasi-experimental lift analysis against non-search control cohorts
experiment_portfolio.limitations: Search engine keyword volume estimates may fluctuate.
experiment_portfolio.next_decision: If search demonstrates qualified intent, transition CHAN-TECH-SEARCH from HYPOTHESIS to PRIMARY channel.

creative_variant_tests.focus: Localhost REST API Daemon Specificity Hook

required_instrumentation: First-party landing page view and download click event logging
Interactive VRAM calculator slider event listener
economics_unknowns: CAC = UNKNOWN (Requires media spend and verified install attribution)
LTV = UNKNOWN (Requires monetization tier and transaction history)
risks: Ad-blocker usage among technical developers may suppress browser-based tracking pixels.
Low-spec host CPU fallback may create post-download latency disappointment without VRAM qualification.
Search keyword volume may fluctuate based on emerging open-weight model releases.

decision_rules.condition: Data quality passes (no SRM), primary metric shows statistically significant positive lift with 95% CI > 0, guardrail metrics remain healthy.
decision_rules.next_step: Scale winning variant distribution within authorized allocation limits.

decision_rules.condition: Primary metric shows directional improvement but confidence interval overlaps zero, or creative demonstrates strong top-funnel hook but high landing drop-off.
decision_rules.next_step: Refine landing page message alignment or test secondary angle without expanding budget.

decision_rules.condition: Guardrail metric breached (e.g. bounce rate increases >20%), or primary conversion rate drops significantly below baseline.
decision_rules.next_step: Halt variant delivery immediately and initiate multi-cause diagnostic review.

decision_rules.condition: Severe tracking anomaly detected (DataQuality failure), or stop-loss threshold reached, or unverified feature claims reported in community feedback.
decision_rules.next_step: Escalate to CMO and technical leads for review before resuming any promotional activity.

decision_rules.condition: Experiment completes duration requirement but sample size or effect size is insufficient to reject null hypothesis at predefined decision threshold.
decision_rules.next_step: Preserve candidate hypothesis as unproven; do not declare a false winner or promote permanent learning.

escalations: Escalate to CMO if DataQualityChecklist detects Sample Ratio Mismatch (SRM) > 1% significance.
Escalate to CMO if total test spend reaches unconfigured stop-loss threshold.
Escalate to CMO if community feedback indicates technical inaccuracies in copy.

candidate_learnings.observation_required: Statistically significant retention lift in PEXP-001 with 95% CI > 0 across 14 days

stop_loss_policy: STOP_LOSS_VALUE = NOT_CONFIGURED (Requires CMO / business stakeholder configuration)
